_comment: Canonical plugin revisions and Go toolchain version for the e2e test repos.
Every please_repo_e2e_test / please_export_e2e_test checks its own repo against this, so a new
test repo is covered automatically rather than quietly keeping whatever version it was copied
from. //test/build_defs:plugin_versions_match_repo_test keeps this file honest against the
versions the please repo itself builds with.
Don't edit this by hand for a plugin the please repo also uses: bump //plugins:BUILD (or
//third_party/go:BUILD for the toolchain) and run `plz run //test/build_defs:fix_plugin_versions`,
which rewrites this file and every test repo to match. For plugins only the test repos use,
edit the revision here and run the same command to push it out.
_local_comment: Plugins served from somewhere in this repo rather than from please-build, so their revisions
are fixtures with no upstream to track. Listed explicitly so that a plugin which is neither
here nor in 'plugins' is reported rather than silently skipped.
